_byline: Claude Code · Opus 5.5 · 2026-10-02 — Kasm 'Devbox (RDP)' Server workspace: Kasm's Guacamole connection proxy opens an RDP session to the devbox's xrdp (P-1 step 3). Full remote access from the browser.
description: The devbox desktop over RDP through Kasm's Guacamole proxy (xrdp on the devbox, host port 13389).

server._credentials: kasm-user's RDP password: devbox custom_startup.sh sets it at container start from /data/probata/secrets/devbox/xrdp.env (mounted read-only by deploy/devbox.yaml). register_kasm.py stores the same value in Kasm's server record so the owner is not prompted. Never in git.
